mcq.q: You call torch.no_grad() during evaluation but not model.eval(). What still happens?
mcq.why: no_grad stops gradient recording only; eval() switches dropout and normalisation to inference mode.

mcq.q: A 10-class classifier's first-step loss is 2.30. This suggests…
options: a uniform starting guess, as expected
mcq.why: ln(10) ≈ 2.30 is the loss of uniform predictions, the normal starting point.
